readerCopy.headline: Growth and duty want different answers.
readerCopy.body:
The opportunity says go. The existing commitment says stay. Money may feel tight at the exact moment the larger option looks most tempting. You may want both and still discover that both plans assume they get the same part of your week.

Jupiter opposing Saturn does not require a dramatic exit. You may need to decide what comes off the calendar, which responsibility can be shared, or which term has to change before the new direction fits. The useful answer is the one that survives after the excitement and the obligation are both still there.
doNotAssume: Do not assume a breakup, resignation, financial loss, or that duty should automatically win.
